description: This file defines the Manufacturer model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for retrieving manufacturer data, including individual records, lists of manufacturers, and layout IDs, from the database. The class interacts with database tables related to manufacturers and uses caching for optimization.
external_files: configuration object for store and language IDs

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: A model class for handling manufacturer data, including retrieval of manufacturer info, list, and layout ID, within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves a single manufacturer record from the database based on manufacturer ID.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturer records, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific manufacturer.
